clarification_targets.question: 本轮 CHANGE_SCOPE 仅授权 walltype-* 的 /attributes，但 15 个墙类型阻塞项（issue_deterministic_gate_0003～0017 及其重复项）要求移除类型上未被请求的材料赋值。请确认：是授权删除全部 walltype-* 的 /materials（实例墙 wall-storey-*-* 上的‘砖’材料按 Design Brief 保留），还是按单一材料 砖 重写类型材料？
同理，3 个板类型（issue_deterministic_gate_0018～0020 及其重复项）需要移除类型上的混凝土材料赋值。请确认授权删除 slabtype-* 的 /materials（实例 slab-ground、slab-storey-2、slab-storey-3 上的‘混凝土’保留），并确认是否允许保留这些未被用户要求共享的 Type 实体及其 definestype 关系？
issue_deterministic_gate_0001/0002 可在授权范围内修复：拟将 stair-1 的 Name 改为与所属层一致的‘第一段楼梯’、stair-2 改为‘第二段楼梯’（两者均为楼层中性的名称，避免跨层显示名冲突）。确认后即可在下一轮与材料问题一并提交 ChangeSet。

losses.message: gate 指认的字段是构件级 /materials，但本包授权路径为 /attributes，两者不相交；在本轮 Scope 内既不能删除墙类型上的材料赋值，也不能删除被 definestype-* 关系引用的墙类型实体（definestype-* 位于 forbidden_ids，且本包 relationship_ids 不含它们），因此该阻塞项无法在本轮修复。
同样的路径不相交问题出现在三个楼板类型上：/materials 未被授权，而删除类型实体会造成 definestype-slab-*（forbidden_ids）悬空，属于隐式级联，被协议禁止。

provenance.note: Deliberately incomplete draft: no entity or relationship content is emitted because 36 of 38 blocking gate issues target /entities/<type>/materials, a path that CHANGE_SCOPE.allowed_paths does not authorize. All omissions are enumerated in missing_facts and losses.

withheld_in_scope_repairs.reason: issue_deterministic_gate_0001 is repairable inside the authorized /attributes prefix, but the package cannot be completed while the material issues stay unresolved, so no partial ChangeSet is emitted.
issue_deterministic_gate_0002 is repairable inside the authorized /attributes prefix, held for the same reason.

provenance.reason: 36 of 38 blocking issues flag /entities/<IfcWallType|IfcSlabType>/materials, which lies outside CHANGE_SCOPE.allowed_paths (only /attributes is authorized for those IDs). Removing the shared Type entities instead would break definestype-* relationships that sit in forbidden_ids and are absent from relationship_ids, i.e. an unauthorized implicit cascade. No user fact is missing for the two stair Name issues, but the package cannot be completed inside the authorized scope, so a canonical Draft Envelope is emitted instead of a partial ChangeSet; component identities, hosts, openings, placement, dimensions, materials on instances and storey layout are left untouched.
